create.name: Freya Bennett-Overstall
create.bio:
Freya Bennett-Overstall teaches qigong, yin yoga and meditation from Maitri Studio Brighton, a small studio of her own in the bayside suburbs of Melbourne. Movement and stillness have been part of her life since childhood, when she did yoga, dance and tai chi, and during more than fifteen years as a chiropractor she began sharing simple breath awareness with the people she saw. After leaving clinical work in 2013 she deepened her own sitting practice and went on to train widely: yin yoga with Bernie Clark and Jo Phee, Insight Yoga with Sarah Powers, Mindful Self-Compassion, and the YOQI method of yoga and qigong with Marisa Cranfill, for which she is now a certified instructor and ambassador.

Her classes are gentle and seasonal, often opening with a poem and a cup of cacao husk tea before moving into qigong, long-held yin postures and guided meditation; many are streamed live on Insight Timer so people can join from anywhere. She also runs longer qigong workshops on sensing and directing energy. Her award-winning book Wonder Full Women: Attune & Bloom draws on Chinese medicine, the seasons of the Kulin Nation and women's stories to offer ways of eating, moving and meditating through the year.

videos.title: Qigong to Release the Past & Accept the Present

books.title: Wonder Full Women. Attune & Bloom. Eat, Move & Meditate with the Seasons
books.author: Freya Bennett-Overstall
books.description: Freya's illustrated guide to living in step with the seasons, published by Balboa Press. It blends Chinese medicine, the seasonal calendar of the Kulin Nation, poetry and women's own stories with practical ideas for food, movement and meditation through the year.

courses.title: Qigong, Yin Yoga & Meditation at Maitri Studio Brighton
courses.description: A one-hour fortnightly class in Freya's Brighton studio during school terms, combining a reading, gentle qigong, yin yoga, herbal tea and guided meditation. Beginners are welcome, and the class is also streamed live on Insight Timer.

courses.title: YOQI Qigong class
courses.description: A fortnightly one-hour qigong class in the YOQI style at Maitri Studio Brighton, held in the garden when the weather allows. Wear soft clothes and come on an empty stomach.

courses.title: YOQI Qigong Workshop: Connecting with Your Life Force
courses.description: A three-and-a-half-hour studio workshop on learning to feel qi and move it on purpose, working through eight energetic directions such as rising, sinking, gathering and dispersing. It lays groundwork for a deeper qigong practice.

courses.title: How To Breathe During A Qigong Practice - Module 1
courses.description: A three-day Insight Timer course of about ten minutes a day on breath in qigong, moving from belly breathing to fuller breath awareness and finishing with a cleansing breath.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Freya Bennett-Overstall on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Freya's guided meditations and recorded classes, plus her fortnightly live qigong, yin yoga and meditation sessions streamed from her studio. Free to join in the app or on the web, with a donation option.
